title.en: Vocational-School Graduate's AI Short Film Goes Viral Overseas - Millions of Views per Episode for Just ~1,000 Yuan
title.zh_hant: 中專生拍出爆火AI短片 海外播放百萬級 單集成本僅千元
title.zh_hans: 中专生拍出爆火AI短片 海外播放百万级 单集成本仅千元

summary.en: An AI short film made independently by a Chinese creator, 'The Girl Who Fell for the Boy Who Lived,' has gone viral overseas, with single episodes reaching millions of views on YouTube, TikTok and other major platforms. The Harry Potter fan film, by creator Foyege, reimagines Draco Malfoy as a woman and builds a romance with Harry Potter; its inventive premise and detailed AI visuals drew a thank-you comment from Western singer JVKE and an approach from Hollywood producer PJ Accetturo. Foyege did not attend a prestigious film school - he studied film and television at a vocational school, started as an editor after graduation, and later worked at a TV advertising company as a director, camera operator and producer. Each episode of the Malfoy series uses about 40,000 LibTV credits, costing roughly 500 to 1,600 yuan. A DataEye report forecasts the overseas AI drama and comic-drama market will exceed US$4 billion in 2026, about 70% of the overseas market, with Chinese overseas short-drama supply shifting from live action to AI-led.
summary.zh_hant: 一部由中國創作者獨立製作的AI短片《愛上大難不死的男孩的女孩》在海外率先出圈，YouTube、TikTok等主流影音平台單集播放量達百萬級。這部《哈利波特》二創短片由帳號Foyege弗曳哥創作，圍繞性轉版馬爾福與哈利波特的浪漫故事展開，憑藉腦洞大開的設定與細膩的AI畫面，吸引歐美歌手JVKE留言致謝，好萊塢製片人PJ Accetturo更主動聯絡合作。創作者並非名校出身，中專讀影視專業，畢業後由剪輯做起，曾任電視廣告公司編導、掌機、製片。馬爾福系列每集約用4萬LibTV積分，折合成本約人民幣500至1,600元。DataEye報告預計，2026年AI劇漫劇海外市場規模將突破40億美元，佔海外大盤近70%，中國出海短劇供給已由真人實拍轉向AI劇為主。
summary.zh_hans: 一部由中国创作者独立制作的AI短片《爱上大难不死的男孩的女孩》在海外率先出圈，YouTube、TikTok等主流影音平台单集播放量达百万级。这部《哈利波特》二创短片由账号Foyege弗曳哥创作，围绕性转版马尔福与哈利波特的浪漫故事展开，凭借脑洞大开的设定与细腻的AI画面，吸引欧美歌手JVKE留言致谢，好莱坞制片人PJ Accetturo更主动联络合作。创作者并非名校出身，中专读影视专业，毕业后由剪辑做起，曾任电视广告公司编导、掌机、制片。马尔福系列每集约用4万LibTV积分，折合成本约人民币500至1,600元。DataEye报告预计，2026年AI剧漫剧海外市场规模将突破40亿美元，占海外大盘近70%，中国出海短剧供给已由真人实拍转向AI剧为主。

title.en: Alibaba's AI music platform HappyShrimp launches: one sentence creates a full song, from RMB 30 a month
title.zh_hant: 阿里AI音樂創作平台「快樂蝦米」上線 一句話生一首歌 內地月費30元起
title.zh_hans: 阿里AI音乐创作平台「快乐虾米」上线 一句话生一首歌 内地月费30元起

summary.en: Alibaba's AI music creation platform HappyShrimp launched its mobile app on 13 November, arriving simultaneously on iOS and Android. Users simply describe an emotion, a story or a music style in natural language, and the AI completes the full process — lyrics, composition, arrangement and vocals — in one go, with no musical background needed to create a complete song. HappyShrimp is the third product in Alibaba's "Happy" series of AI models, built around end-to-end, full-song generation; a web beta was released in August. On pricing, standard membership in mainland China costs about RMB 30 a month for 150 songs — around RMB 0.2 per song — while overseas membership starts at US$14.9 a month, with credit packs from US$9.9.
summary.zh_hant: 阿里巴巴旗下AI音樂創作平台「快樂蝦米」（HappyShrimp）11月13日正式推出手機應用程式，同步登陸iOS及Android平台。用戶只需以自然語言描述想表達的情緒、故事或音樂風格，AI即可一氣呵成完成歌詞、作曲、編曲與人聲演唱，毋須任何音樂基礎就能生成一整首歌。快樂蝦米是阿里「Happy系列」AI模型的第三個產品，主打端到端整曲一體化生成，今年8月已先推出網頁測試版。收費方面，內地標準會員每月約30元人民幣，可生成150首歌，平均每首約0.2元；海外會員月費14.9美元起，積分包9.9美元起。
summary.zh_hans: 阿里巴巴旗下AI音乐创作平台「快乐虾米」（HappyShrimp）11月13日正式推出手机应用程序，同步登陆iOS及Android平台。用户只需以自然语言描述想表达的情绪、故事或音乐风格，AI即可一气呵成完成歌词、作曲、编曲与人声演唱，无须任何音乐基础就能生成一整首歌。快乐虾米是阿里「Happy系列」AI模型的第三个产品，主打端到端整曲一体化生成，今年8月已先推出网页测试版。收费方面，内地标准会员每月约30元人民币，可生成150首歌，平均每首约0.2元；海外会员月费14.9美元起，积分包9.9美元起。

title.en: Xinhua says parties hope China's plan brings more certainty to Asia-Pacific development as the APEC summit opens in Shenzhen on Wednesday
title.zh_hant: 新華社：各方盼中國方案為亞太發展注入更多確定性 APEC深圳峰會周三登場
title.zh_hans: 新华社：各方盼中国方案为亚太发展注入更多确定性 APEC深圳峰会周三登场

summary.en: Xinhua has published an article titled "Working to open a new era of Asia-Pacific development", saying the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen on Wednesday and Thursday, with President Xi Jinping attending the meeting and related events, marking a highlight of the APEC "China Year". The article says the world stands at a new crossroads, with unilateralism and protectionism undercurrents, geopolitical conflicts disrupting industrial and supply chains, and a faltering global economic recovery, and all parties are eager for a peaceful, stable and predictable development environment, hoping the "China plan" will bring more certainty to the future development of the Asia-Pacific. It adds that the APEC "China Year" coincides with the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, and a China steadily advancing towards Chinese modernisation will keep deepening reform and opening its doors to cooperation, turning the dividends of high-quality development into shared opportunities that benefit the Asia-Pacific and the world.
summary.zh_hant: 新華社發表題為「努力開創亞太發展新時代」的文章，指出亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議將於星期三至四在深圳舉行，國家主席習近平將出席會議及相關活動，APEC「中國年」迎來高光時刻。文章說，當今世界又站在新的十字路口，單邊主義、保護主義暗流湧動，地緣衝突擾動產業鏈供應鏈，全球經濟復蘇步履維艱，各方更加渴望和平穩定、可預期的發展環境，期待「中國方案」為亞太未來發展注入更多確定性。文章又指，APEC「中國年」恰逢「十五五」開局之年，一個向著中國式現代化穩步邁進的中國，持續深化改革，敞開合作大門，將高質量發展的紅利轉化為惠及亞太、造福世界的共同機遇。
summary.zh_hans: 新华社发表题为「努力开创亚太发展新时代」的文章，指出亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议将于星期三至四在深圳举行，国家主席习近平将出席会议及相关活动，APEC「中国年」迎来高光时刻。文章说，当今世界又站在新的十字路口，单边主义、保护主义暗流涌动，地缘冲突扰动产业链供应链，全球经济复苏步履维艰，各方更加渴望和平稳定、可预期的发展环境，期待「中国方案」为亚太未来发展注入更多确定性。文章又指，APEC「中国年」恰逢「十五五」开局之年，一个向着中国式现代化稳步迈进的中国，持续深化改革，敞开合作大门，将高质量发展的红利转化为惠及亚太、造福世界的共同机遇。

title.en: South Korean exam candidate used a hidden camera and AI to score near-perfect marks and top the tax exam as the Blue House scrambles before the university entrance test
title.zh_hant: 韓國考生用微型鏡頭加AI作弊 160題只錯1題奪第一 青瓦台急商高考對策
title.zh_hans: 韩国考生用微型镜头加AI作弊 160题只错1题夺第一 青瓦台急商高考对策

summary.en: A candidate in South Korea's certified tax accountant examination has been found to have cheated with a miniature camera and artificial intelligence, scoring so highly that he came first. In the first stage of the exam, which has 160 questions, he got only one wrong, with full marks in three of the four subjects, and his unusually outstanding results raised suspicion. He surrendered to police yesterday, admitting that in both stages of the tax accountant exam and in the certified public accountant exam he used a miniature camera to photograph the questions, sent them to generative AI, and used a smartphone to obtain the answers. Presidential Chief of Staff Lim Kwang-hyun said the Blue House held an emergency meeting on the matter, and with South Korea's university entrance examination due on Thursday, the relevant departments are working flat out on preventive measures.
summary.zh_hant: 韓國一名註冊稅務師考試考生被揭發利用微型攝錄鏡頭及人工智能作弊，以超高分數獲得第一名。涉事考生在第一階段考試160道題目中只錯了一題，四科中有三科滿分，成績異常突出引人質疑，他昨日向警方自首，承認在稅務師一、二試及註冊會計師考試中，曾用微型攝錄鏡頭拍攝考題，傳送到生成式AI，再借助智能手機獲取答案。韓國總統秘書室長林光鉉表示，青瓦台召開緊急會議商討對策，鑒於韓國高考將於星期四舉行，有關部門正全力研究及制定防範措施。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国一名注册税务师考试考生被揭发利用微型摄录镜头及人工智能作弊，以超高分数获得第一名。涉事考生在第一阶段考试160道题目中只错了一题，四科中有三科满分，成绩异常突出引人质疑，他昨日向警方自首，承认在税务师一、二试及注册会计师考试中，曾用微型摄录镜头拍摄考题，传送到生成式AI，再借助智能手机获取答案。韩国总统秘书室长林光铉表示，青瓦台召开紧急会议商讨对策，鉴于韩国高考将于星期四举行，有关部门正全力研究及制定防范措施。

title.en: Iran parliament completes review of Hormuz strait plan as agreed shipping lanes go live on a temporary basis
title.zh_hant: 伊朗議會完成霍爾木茲海峽方案審議 商定航道先臨時實施再轉永久
title.zh_hans: 伊朗议会完成霍尔木兹海峡方案审议 商定航道先临时实施再转永久

summary.en: The spokesman for Iran's parliamentary National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, Kashkavand, said the committee has completed its expert review of the plan concerning the Strait of Hormuz and reached agreement with two coastal states on the shipping lanes. Iran's Tasnim news agency reported that Iran held several rounds of talks in Tehran and in the Omani capital Muscat, and the agreed lanes will first be implemented on a temporary basis before becoming a permanent arrangement. Kashkavand also said Iran has never initiated aggression and is currently in a defensive state, adding that under international law Iran considers itself to be in a state of war in the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗議會國家安全與外交政策委員會發言人卡什卡維表示，委員會已完成霍爾木茲海峽相關方案的專業審議，就通行航道與兩個沿岸國家達成協議。伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社報道，伊朗曾在首都德黑蘭和阿曼首都馬斯喀特舉行多輪會談，商定的航道將先以臨時方式實施，之後轉為永久安排。卡什卡維又說，伊朗從未主動發動侵略，目前處於防禦狀態，根據國際法，伊方認為伊朗目前在波斯灣及阿曼灣地區都處於戰爭狀態。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗议会国家安全与外交政策委员会发言人卡什卡维表示，委员会已完成霍尔木兹海峡相关方案的专业审议，就通行航道与两个沿岸国家达成协议。伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，伊朗曾在首都德黑兰和阿曼首都马斯喀特举行多轮会谈，商定的航道将先以临时方式实施，之后转为永久安排。卡什卡维又说，伊朗从未主动发动侵略，目前处于防御状态，根据国际法，伊方认为伊朗目前在波斯湾及阿曼湾地区都处于战争状态。

title.en: Lavrov says Moscow will never accept a Ukraine deal that ignores Russia's interests as EU seeks a late seat at the talks
title.zh_hant: 拉夫羅夫拒不顧俄利益烏克蘭方案 批歐盟最後關頭想入局卻不知角色
title.zh_hans: 拉夫罗夫拒不顾俄利益乌克兰方案 批欧盟最后关头想入局却不知角色

summary.en: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said a European Union plan for Ukraine that fails to take Russia's interests into account is absolutely unworkable, and Moscow will not agree to any solution that ignores Russian interests. Russian media reported on Sunday that Lavrov was responding to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's position that negotiations on Ukraine must start from a ceasefire, saying the EU wants to join the Ukraine talks at the last moment, yet its remarks show it does not really know what role it could play in the negotiations. Lavrov stressed that in the Ukraine negotiations, Russia insists on achieving the goals of its special military operation as a precondition, and that has never changed.
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫表示，歐盟在解決烏克蘭問題的方案上若不考慮俄方利益，絕對行不通，俄方不會同意任何罔顧俄羅斯利益的解決方案。俄羅斯傳媒星期日報道，拉夫羅夫回應歐盟委員會主席馮德萊恩有關烏克蘭問題談判須以停火為前提的表態時指出，歐盟想在最後時刻參與烏克蘭問題談判，但歐方的言論表明他們並不清楚自己能在談判中扮演甚麼角色。拉夫羅夫強調，俄羅斯在烏克蘭問題談判上堅持以實現特別軍事行動目標為前提，這一點從未改變。
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫表示，欧盟在解决乌克兰问题的方案上若不考虑俄方利益，绝对行不通，俄方不会同意任何罔顾俄罗斯利益的解决方案。俄罗斯传媒星期日报道，拉夫罗夫回应欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩有关乌克兰问题谈判须以停火为前提的表态时指出，欧盟想在最后时刻参与乌克兰问题谈判，但欧方的言论表明他们并不清楚自己能在谈判中扮演什么角色。拉夫罗夫强调，俄罗斯在乌克兰问题谈判上坚持以实现特别军事行动目标为前提，这一点从未改变。

title.en: Three fires in one day at Lower Wong Tai Sin Estate leave one dead; 92-year-old put rice cooker on gas stove
title.zh_hant: 黃大仙下邨一日三火釀1死 92歲婆婆誤將電飯煲放上煤氣爐 150居民自行疏散
title.zh_hans: 黄大仙下邨一日三火酿1死 92岁婆婆误将电饭煲放上煤气炉 150居民自行疏散

summary.en: Lower Wong Tai Sin Estate saw three separate fires in a single day on 15 November. A morning blaze at Lung Kwong House killed an 80-year-old woman living alone, with about 300 residents evacuating themselves. At midday, a 15-year-old boy set tissue paper alight with a lighter after quarrelling with his father at Lung Yue House, and the flames were out before firefighters arrived. In the evening, a 92-year-old woman surnamed Fung put an electric rice cooker on a gas stove at Lung Wo House, starting a kitchen fire that was brought under control in about 25 minutes; about 150 residents made their own way out and the woman was treated for suspected smoke inhalation without needing hospital care. Fire services believe none of the three fires was suspicious.
summary.zh_hant: 黃大仙下邨11月15日一日內發生三宗火警。早上龍光樓低層單位起火，80歲獨居婦人不治，約300名住戶自行疏散；中午龍躍樓一名15歲少年與父親爭執後，用打火機點燃紙巾，消防到場前火勢已經撲熄；傍晚龍窩樓16樓單位廚房起火，92歲姓馮女戶主疑誤將電飯煲當作普通煲放在煤氣爐上煮食，約25分鐘後救熄，約150名居民自行疏散，婦人吸入濃煙後在地面接受治療，毋須送院。消防初步調查相信三宗火警均無可疑。
summary.zh_hans: 黄大仙下邨11月15日一日内发生三宗火警。早上龙光楼低层单位起火，80岁独居妇人不治，约300名住户自行疏散；中午龙跃楼一名15岁少年与父亲争执后，用打火机点燃纸巾，消防到场前火势已经扑熄；傍晚龙窝楼16楼单位厨房起火，92岁姓冯女户主疑误将电饭煲当作普通煲放在煤气炉上煮食，约25分钟后救熄，约150名居民自行疏散，妇人吸入浓烟后在地面接受治疗，毋须送院。消防初步调查相信三宗火警均无可疑。
